Let the Lake Work its Magic and Let the Forest Work its Wonders
The Cliff Dweller is pleased to welcome you to the rugged beauty of Minnesota's North Shore.
Welcome to Cliff Dweller Hotel , your lakeside retreat just north of Tofte, Minnesota. Nestled on the breathtaking shores of Lake Superior, our hotel offers a serene getaway where every room features a balcony, giving you front-row seats to spectacular sunrises and the calming sound of the waves. Cliff Dweller provides the perfect location for exploring the best of the North Shore. Our Tofte lodging is just a five-minute drive from the slopes at Lutsen Mountains, making it ideal for skiing enthusiasts during the winter months. In the summer and fall, you can hike scenic trails, chase waterfalls at nearby Cascade River State Park, or simply relax and take in the views. Cliff Dweller is also one of the few pet friendly hotels on the North Shore. Bring your furry friend with you and stay in one of our first floor rooms. As a favorite Tofte hotel , we’re committed to ensuring your stay is as relaxing and enjoyable as possible.
About Us
Cliff Dweller is perched cliff side on the edge of the lake in the heart of the Minnesota’s North Shore, and offers a unique combination of comfort and style with 22 south facing guest rooms. Each room has a walk-out balcony with dramatic 180-degree views of the big lake and Sawtooth Mountains shoreline to the west. The whisper or roar of the waves on the rocks below will surely lull you to sleep, and help you relax and unwind. No matter the season of the year and the activity you pursue, you can look forward to returning to the cozy accommodations at the Cliff Dweller for a restful night.
Lovely lake views for all
Our room was impeccably clean and had a wonderful view of Lake Superior. There is a microwave and mini-fridge in the room. We enjoyed leaving the patio doors open to hear the waves on the rocks, but when closed, they provided impressive sound proofing from a thunderstorm. Yes, the moon (and lightning storm!) views over the lake are spectacular.
- MNtravels09, TripAdvisor
Clean and comfortable
Family owned and operated motel. They are committed to providing clean rooms and comfort. Ask the front desk for a coffee maker if you need one in your room. We really enjoyed sitting on the balcony and looking out over the lake.
- HappyMinsky, TripAdvisor
Great place to stay
Great hosts running the hotel. Very comfortable accommodations with rooms overlooking Lake Superior from their balcony. The fresh cool breeze off the lake at night comes wafting through the screen making for a beautiful sleep. Our group stayed for a few days - hiking, kayaking and biking in the area. There are some good places to eat in the area as well.
- George H., TripAdvisor
Friendly staff and excellent location
Staff was super friendly and helpful to find local hiking destinations and amenities. The rooms are spacious, extremely clean, and the view cannot be beat! I’ve stayed in a lot of hotels on the north shore, you won’t find a better one than this!
- Erin S., Google Reviews
Great view and clean room
I have stayed here twice now, and will definitely stay here in the future when we visit. The rooms are clean, simple, and have great lakeside views of Lake Superior.
- Lori E., Google Reviews
Convenient and clean
The room was very clean and comfortable. Had our own deck, even with it being a bit chilly, sat out on it during the afternoon and enjoyed the lake being right there. Chatted with the main staff member who was wonderful and it was obvious she took great pride in how things are run at the hotel. Would definitely stay again when in the area. So conveniently located to Lutsen and all the other beautiful attractions along the shore.
- Elaine H., Google Reviews
Will stay again
Great front desk customer service, very clean rooms. The view from my room was amazing! Close to Lutsen! I will stay here again when in the area.
- Joel B., Google Reviews
Amazing staff and perfect views!
Beautiful property located right on the lakefront. Comfortable, clean, rustic-themed rooms have gorgeous views of the lake and a wonderful deck on which to enjoy them. They offer a lovely start-your-day-off-on-the-right-note coffee/tea/hot chocolate and delicious pastry mini breakfast in a sunroom overlooking the lake. Angelia, at the front desk and everywhere, is professional, friendly, and always available to make sure your stay is perfect.
- Leslie, Booking.com
Exceptional
Host was extremely friendly and helpful! Location and view were great. Room was clean and bed was comfortable. Super great stay!!!
- Michael, Booking.com

Lake Superior Accommodations-Lutsen-Tofte MN Lodging | Cliff Dweller on Lake Superior
Your Bed Next to the Big Lake
The Cliff Dweller on Lake Superior features comfortable and inviting guest rooms, each complete with either two double beds or a single king bed.
All 22 guest rooms are tastefully decorated to be modern and stylish, but with a rustic, natural feel. Guest rooms feature sliding glass doors leading to individual balconies overlooking the beautiful and immense Lake Superior.
All rooms are equipped with comfortable Happy Sleeper mattress, deluxe bedding and towels, eco-friendly bath amenities, flat screen TV’s, oscillating fans, high speed internet, etc.
Cozy up and let the lake lull you to dreamy sleep
Imagine waking up to a gentle sound or a roar of waves against the shore, basking in the warmth of the sun streaming through your window, and gazing out at a panoramic view of the vast lake streaming out before you. This tranquil experience can be found and had at every guest room at the Cliff Dweller on Lake Superior. Our rooms provide sense of comfort and warmth. The natural beauty of Lake Superior is complemented by the charming decor and cozy comfort of the room. If you are looking to escape and unwind, or have a perfect spot as you explore the area, the Cliff Dweller on Lake Superior is your perfect landing place.
Lodging On Minnesota’s North Shore Of Lake Superior
If you are searching for lodging on the North Shore that feels calm, practical, and connected to the outdoors, Cliff Dweller offers a simple place to land. Our location sits directly above Lake Superior just outside of Lutsen, with wide water views and immediate access to the Gitchi Gami Trail. Guests stay here because they want quiet evenings, easy mornings, and a central base for exploring the shoreline without long drives.
This stretch of the North Shore is known for rocky coastlines, cool lake air, and fast access to state parks, scenic overlooks, and small towns. Staying right on the lake changes how the trip feels. You wake up to waves, not traffic, and you end your day watching the light shift across the water.
Hotels On The North Shore With Direct Lake Access
Many hotels on the North Shore are set back from the lake or across Highway 61. Cliff Dweller is different. Every stay here keeps Lake Superior in view and within earshot. That matters during storm season in fall, calm summer mornings, and quiet winter nights when the shoreline feels almost private.
Guests often tell us they chose this location because it feels removed without being remote. You can walk or bike the Gitchi Gami Trail straight from the property, drive to Grand Marais for shopping and dining, or a minute east to Lutsen for skiing, hiking, and gondola rides. Because we are situated just outside of Lutsen, our guests don’t have to deal with the hustle and bustle of the town, without sacrificing easy access to the slopes. Cliff Dweller is technically located in Tofte, but it’s situated at the halfway point between Lutsen and the town of Tofte proper. For golfers, we are also just 5 minutes away from Superior National Golf Course.
Places To Stay On The North Shore For Couples And Small Families
Travelers looking for places to stay on the North Shore often want flexibility. Some trips are about hiking and waterfalls. Others are about rest, reading, and long views of the lake. Our lodging works well for both.
You will find:
Lake facing rooms with decks
Quiet common areas designed for reading, conversation, or watching the water
This is not a resort atmosphere. There are no scheduled activities or fire pits. The experience is intentionally simple so the lake and landscape stay front and center.
Lodging Near Lutsen With Easy Year Round Access
Finding lodging near Lutsen that stays quiet during peak seasons can be a challenge. Cliff Dweller sits just west of Lutsen, which keeps you close to the area’s most popular attractions while avoiding the busiest traffic pockets.
In winter, guests stay here for downhill skiing and Nordic trails at Lutsen Mountains, then return to a calm shoreline setting. In summer and fall, the same location works well for hiking Temperance River State Park or Cascade River State Park, driving the scenic highway, or taking short trips to Grand Marais without relocating each night.
What To Expect When Staying Here
Travelers often ask practical questions before booking hotels on the North Shore. Here is what helps most guests decide if Cliff Dweller is a good fit.
Q: Is this a good place to stay if I want quiet and scenery more than nightlife
A: Yes. Evenings here are typically quiet, with lake sounds and minimal road noise. Guests who want bars and live music usually drive into Grand Marais, Tofte, or Lutsen and return here to sleep.
Q: Can I walk or bike without driving once I arrive
A: Yes. The Gitchi Gami Trail runs directly alongside the property and connects to miles of paved and natural surface trail along the shore.
Q: Is this lodging convenient for day trips along the North Shore
A: Yes. You are positioned between major parks, overlooks, and towns, which reduces backtracking and long drives during peak travel seasons.
A Straightforward Place To Stay On The North Shore
If you are comparing places to stay on the North Shore and want something grounded, quiet, and directly connected to Lake Superior, Cliff Dweller offers a clear option. This is lodging for travelers who value location, rest, and access to the shoreline over extras they may not use.
Many guests return because the experience stays consistent from season to season. The lake changes every day, but the pace here stays steady.
